vocabulary.example: It's normal to feel nervous before a presentation.
vocabulary.example_cz: Je normální cítit se před prezentací nervózní.
vocabulary.tts_text: It's normal to feel nervous before a presentation.

vocabulary.example: Take a deep breath before you start.
vocabulary.tts_text: Take a deep breath before you start.

vocabulary.example: I practiced this presentation many times.
vocabulary.example_cz: Tuto prezentaci jsem si mnohokrát procvičil.
vocabulary.tts_text: I practiced this presentation many times.

vocabulary.example: Try to stay calm even if you make a mistake.
vocabulary.example_cz: Snažte se zůstat klidní, i když uděláte chybu.
vocabulary.tts_text: Try to stay calm even if you make a mistake.

vocabulary.example: Keep eye contact with the audience.
vocabulary.tts_text: Keep eye contact with the audience.

vocabulary.example: Pace yourself and don't speak too fast.
vocabulary.example_cz: Rozvrhněte si tempo a nemluvte příliš rychle.
vocabulary.tts_text: Pace yourself and don't speak too fast.

vocabulary.example: If you make a mistake, just continue calmly.
vocabulary.tts_text: If you make a mistake, just continue calmly.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'm really nervous about this presentation.
lines.text_cz: Jsem z té prezentace opravdu nervózní.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's normal. Take a deep breath and remember you practiced a lot.
lines.text_cz: To je normální. Zhluboka se nadechni a vzpomeň si, žes to hodně procvičoval.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What if I make a mistake?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Just stay calm and continue. Keep eye contact and pace yourself.
lines.text_cz: Prostě zůstaň klidný a pokračuj. Udržuj oční kontakt a rozvrhni si tempo.
